Conversion of the class ltraj to the package sp

Source: R/ltraj2spdf.R
ltraj2spdf.Rd

Modified versions of ltraj2spdf and ltraj2sldf, which allows to aggregate by burst (default), id, or step (parameter "by").

Usage

ltraj2spdf(ltr, strict = TRUE)

ltraj2sldf(ltr, by = c("burst", "id", "step"), strict = TRUE)

Arguments

ltr

An object of class ltraj.

strict

Logical (TRUE by default). See ld. For ltraj2sldf, only applies to by = "step".

by

Sets the level of aggregation: if id, one object of class Lines corresponds to one animal; if burst (default), it corresponds to one burst; if step, it corresponds to one step.

Note

The conversion to SLDF using by = "step" is significantly longer, of a factor of ~50, than the other two (it takes about 10 sec for each 10,000 steps on a modern computer).

See also

See ltraj2spdf for further details on the function and all available arguments.

Author

Clement Calenge, modified by Mathieu Basille mathieu@basille.org

Examples

## Load puechcirc data, and add some random infolocs:
data(puechcirc)
info <- list(data.frame(A = rnorm(80), B = runif(80), C = rpois(80,
    1)), data.frame(A = rnorm(69, 10), B = runif(69, 10, 11),
    C = rpois(69, 10)), data.frame(A = rnorm(66, -10), B = runif(66,
    -10, -9), C = rpois(66, 100)))
## Watch the row names (for a reason, 'puechcirc[[2]]' starts with line 2):
info <- mapply(function(x, y) {
    row.names(x) <- row.names(y)
    return(x)
}, info, puechcirc, SIMPLIFY = FALSE)
infolocs(puechcirc) <- info

## Conversion to SPDF:
summary(adehabitatLT::ltraj2spdf(puechcirc))
